remarks: Heat & hot water are included with the rent. This charming third-floor, one-bedroom apartment in Stamford, Connecticut, offers a cozy and functional living space with modern conveniences. Upon entering, you'll find a sunlit living room with large windows, providing a relaxing space to unwind or entertain. The kitchen features updated appliances, sleek countertops, and ample cabinet storage. The bedroom is spacious, with a large closet for storage and enough room for a queen or king sized bed. The bathroom offers great comfort. Being on the third floor, the apartment enjoys added privacy and elevated views, overlooking Stamford's vibrant downtown. Residents also benefit from proximity to public transportation, dining, shopping, and local parks. This unit is ideal for a professional or couple seeking a comfortable, urban retreat in a thriving city. Storage space and laundry room are located in the lower level. Schedule a viewing today!
